title: Show HN: my weekend project, jetsetter
guide_zh: 频繁旅行催生了周末项目 jetsetter，作者分享这次个人开发尝试。
author: paulsingh
excerpt: I've been traveling quite a bit for the last few weeks and thought it might be cool to have my laptop "check in" every few hours. So far, so good. The idea is for jetsetter to generate cool maps and other info about your habits... sort of like Dopplr, but for your laptop. It's still pretty ghetto, but becoming kind of interesting... thought I'd share it and see if you guys find it useful too.
